notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Ornithopter.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {1}.
When Ornithopter dies, Sword of the Realms and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ornithopter to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

uses.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
